settings.heading: In my PC Era
settings.subheading: An affordable luxury house built for every version of her.

settings.heading: Fashion shouldn't only be saved for occasions
settings.body: PC Era began with a simple belief: every girl moves through different eras of her life — and she deserves to feel elevated in all of them. The confident era. The soft girl era. The vacation era. The healing era. The main character era. We were tired of choosing between clothes that looked designer and clothes we could actually afford. So we built the brand we wished existed.

settings.heading: What “In My PC Era” means
settings.body:
An era isn't a trend — it's a feeling. It's the chapter you're living right now. PC Era exists to dress that chapter, so getting dressed feels intentional, not accidental. Everyday moments — coffee, pilates, a slow Sunday — become a little more cinematic.

Quiet luxury, European-summer ease, Pinterest-board beauty. Made accessible.
settings.signature: Every version of her, dressed beautifully.

settings.heading: From a moodboard to a movement
settings.body: PC Era was founded by a girl who lived on Pinterest and Instagram, screenshotting outfits she could never quite find — luxurious, minimal, editorial, but real-life wearable and fairly priced. She decided to make them herself. What started as a single linen set became a wardrobe for the modern girl moving through her eras.
